description: PHASE 00 vertical slice: drive the real DSH runtime through the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-client
//: The @deepseek-ai/cordis* pins mirror the peer ranges declared by @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot and the versions shipped inside the working global dsh 0.1.5 install. npm 10 cannot resolve this graph on its own: the newer cordis-plugin-timer@1.2.0 and cordis-plugin-include@1.1.0 require cordis ~4.1.0 while dsh-app-boot pins cordis 4.0.2 exactly, so caret ranges drift into an unsolvable tree. Pinning the whole family keeps `npm install` reproducible without --legacy-peer-deps. See docs/phase-reports/PHASE_00_EVIDENCE.md.
